notes.title: Playtest Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42095098/8ffcece9c8997cf5aa64e606b591f21aacbebeca.png[/img]

[h1]The First Playtest of Wish Talk is Available Now![/h1]

The test will run until May 11th.
Explore the island and build up a friendship with toy dolls by talking to them and find out their stories.

[h3]Come join the adventure,and request for access on this page![/h3]

Please note:
If you request for access, the Wish Talk team will approve it as soon as possible. But please be noted that approvals may see a delay during 8:00AM~4:00PM.
